name: Residual add + RMSNorm
description: Compute h = x + residual, then RMSNorm(h) with weight and eps=1e-6 over the last dimension. Return only the normalized output. Compute in float32; inputs/output bfloat16.
signature: run(x: Tensor[M, N], residual: Tensor[M, N], weight: Tensor[N]) -> Tensor[M, N]
provenance: Original KernelRL task (written from scratch). Task category inspired by KernelBench level 2 (github.com/ScalingIntelligence/KernelBench, MIT license); no KernelBench code copied.
